summary: Late reconnect snapshots cause mismatched terminal headers and duplicate final fragments on SSE
description:
Issue summary:
Customers using SSE streaming to a Dedicated pool see cases where the finalization metadata (terminal headers) for a completed choice is either missing or duplicated after a reconnect. In affected sessions a reconnect that happens late (after the runtime emitted final token fragments but before client ACK/close) results in two partial final fragments and no consolidated terminal header (choice_final=true, reason=stop) attached to either fragment.

Impact:
- TileCloud reports truncated transcript in production chat flows (missing final metadata prevents client SDK from persisting final choice).
- Rare but high-impact: results in application-level timeouts and duplicate persisted messages.

Environment:
- Dedicated capacity (customer pool id: dc-06b2)
- Production (us-east-1)
- Ingests via edge API (api.redwood.example -> internal gateway -> runtime)

Observed behavior:
- Client receives two final token fragments that both appear to be tail fragments of the same choice. Neither fragment carries the terminal headers expected by the SDK (no "final_choice":true header, no final reason metadata).
- Session trace shows runtime wrote a session snapshot on disconnect and then accepted a resume that merged an older snapshot ID, producing duplicated partial fragments.

Expected behavior:
- After resume the stream should deliver a single final fragment annotated with terminal headers/metadata, or if duplicate fragments happen the runtime should attach terminal metadata to the final emitted fragment and suppress duplicates for client SDKs.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start an SSE chat session against the dedicated pool with a long final token buffer (example prompt that produces a 500-700 token final choice).
2) Simulate a client-side reconnect by closing TCP (or letting a proxy do a half-close) right after the server emits most of the final tokens but before the app-layer final ACK/End marker is sent,
3) Re-establish the SSE connection with the same session id within ~3s. Observe the resumed stream events and metadata.
logs: TraceID: trace-7f9b1c - runtime emitted fragments: fragment-12345 (final-part-1), fragment-12346 (final-part-2) - neither contains 'terminal: true' header.
Gateway log: resume request contained X-Session-Snapshot: snap-v3, runtime active snapshot: snap-v4 - runtime merged snap-v3 into active state and replayed tail fragments.
Edge proxy (haproxy) connection log: client closed connection at 2026-03-09T14:21:12.123Z, new connection resumed at 2026-03-09T14:21:14.371Z.
investigation_notes: 03/10 - Maya: Initial customer report and attached client-side dump and raw SSE transcript; reproduced in a staging Dedicated pool with a tooling harness.

03/11 - SRE (Arjun): Correlated runtime traces to gateway resume path. Found resume handler accepts older snapshot versions when incoming snapshot header is present and merges by replaying deltas. This merge path doesn't reconcile terminal metadata for choices emitted just before the disconnect.

03/11 - Eng (runtime): Confirmed logic in snapshot merge path (session_manager/merge_snapshots) will re-emit buffered fragments on resume. Terminal headers are only attached when fragment emission completes in the canonical snapshot, so replays can omit finalization metadata.
03/12 - Test: Reproduced deterministically by forcing an artificial 'emit then drop' window; reproducer saved as repro/stream-snapshot-replay.sh in internal artifacts.
hypothesis: When a reconnect supplies an older session snapshot id (e.g., due to proxy connection reuse or client sending stale snapshot header), the runtime merges the older snapshot into the current session and replays buffered tail fragments. The replay path re-emits token fragments but does not re-attach terminal metadata, causing clients to see duplicate partial finals and missing terminal headers.
workaround: TileCloud switched the client to use websocket fallback for the short-term and disabled proxy connection pooling between client and edge (set 'Connection: close') to avoid stale snapshot ids being forwarded. Both actions stopped new occurrences.
resolution_notes: Eng has a branch that: (1) validates incoming snapshot id against the active session generation and refuses resume if the incoming snapshot is older than current by more than 1 generation (configurable), and (2) attaches terminal metadata during replay of any final fragments. Patch PR: runtime/pull/2197. Pending QA and rollout to Dedicated pools. Plan to roll to a canary pool on 2026-03-15.
next_steps: 1) Roll PR runtime/pull/2197 to canary Dedicated pool (owner: Arjun).
2) Add an e2e regression test for late-resume path to ensure terminal metadata is preserved,
3) Update docs and SDK to tolerate duplicate tail fragments if terminal header is present or to request full-resume semantics via an explicit flag,
4) Notify TileCloud prior to canary deploy and schedule a 1-hour maintenance window if needed.
